onboarding.title: Book your spot
onboarding.description: Pick a day, up to 6 one-hour slots, your floor, and your spot.

onboarding.title: Scan to check in
onboarding.description: Scan your spot’s QR code within 30 minutes of your start time. No check-in? Your spot becomes available again. Leaving early? Check out to free it up.

onboarding.title: Walk-ins welcome
onboarding.description: No booking? No problem. Use any free spot. If someone with a booking arrives, they get priority.
